mechanics.claim: Azir dashes to the targeted Sand Soldier and deals magic damage to enemies within his path.
mechanics.quote: dashes to the {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} closest to the cursor, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within his path

mechanics.claim: If Azir dashes into an enemy champion, he stops there and gains a charge of Arise!.
mechanics.quote: If '''Azir''' dashes into an enemy {{tip|champion}}, he stops and gains a charge of ''{{ai|Arise!|Azir}}''.

mechanics.claim: A summoned Sand Soldier is required to cast this ability, and Azir can cast other abilities during the dash.
mechanics.quote: A summoned {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} is required to cast this ability. '''Azir''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash.

mechanics.claim: Movement and attack commands are canceled on cast and cannot be issued until Azir finishes the dash.
mechanics.quote: Movement and attack commands will be canceled upon cast and cannot be issued again until '''Azir''' arrives at his final location.

mechanics.claim: The shield is granted to Azir himself upon cast.
